review_scope: Completed specification artifact only; packet-only review with no source re-verification. The packet truncates 830 bytes from the report reference tail; that omitted content was not reviewed.

findings.claim: The report omits the committed TypeScript 7.0 and kebab-case file requirements without identifying that part of the research question as unanswered.
findings.evidence: The fourth sub-question in goals and research_plan asks how shared React preserves "kebab-case TypeScript 7.0 files". The report proposes "One implementation with injected shell transport" and desktop chrome responsibilities, but contains no TypeScript 7.0 or kebab-case treatment, evidence, or explicit unresolved item.
findings.suggested_fix: Carry those requirements into the shared React ownership contract and explicitly state whether TypeScript 7.0 availability/toolchain compatibility was established or remains an adoption prerequisite. Do not infer compatibility from sibling build scripts.

findings.claim: The native harness/model/export configuration sub-question has no concrete configuration inventory or explicit statement that its configuration inspection was not completed.
findings.evidence: The last sub-question asks "Which native harness/model/export capabilities are actually configured, and what remains source-only or unverified?" Research_plan assigns "Root inspects team/cadence tooling and model policies." The report answers only that "The three dossiers do not provide native-harness invocation receipts, so native agent support remains source/configuration evidence only." It names no inspected harness configuration, available model binding, export capability, or source for any such configuration.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the inspected harness/model/export configuration findings and their labels, or state explicitly that this inventory was not established and remains a prerequisite to installing and exporting the proposed team. Keep configuration evidence separate from invocation evidence.
